en: In a vacuum, a heavy bowling ball and a light feather fall at the exact same rate due to gravity.
Static friction prevents a parked jeepney from sliding down a steep hill even before its wheels start moving.
A pulley system reduces the effort force needed to lift a load, but the total work done remains identical.
Permanent magnets strongly attract nickel and cobalt metals, proving they do not only attract iron.
Electrical current flows in one continuous loop through a closed circuit instead of leaking out of the battery.
Sound waves travel much faster through solid steel rails than through the air around us.
Light waves can travel through the empty vacuum of outer space without needing any physical medium.
Thermal energy always flows from a hot object, like boiling water, into a colder object, never the reverse.
A third-class lever, like a fishing rod, multiplies distance and speed instead of multiplying force.
Aluminum and copper are metals, but they are not attracted to standard permanent magnets.
Car brakes convert kinetic energy into heat energy through friction instead of destroying the energy.
White sunlight is not a single color, but actually a mixture of all visible rainbow colors combined.
